what_this_is: Five situations put to the recorded tier-1 order and tier-2 pairing that batch 26 introduced, one of them driven by the clean-room run's own conclusions.csv -- the data that broke batch 25.

drifted_conclusions.what_it_does: swaps in the clean-room run's conclusions.csv, which the tier-2 rule ranks on, and re-plans
drifted_conclusions.verdict: the rule would now choose 6 different pair(s); the recorded ones stand
drifted_conclusions.why_this_is_the_test: batch 25 re-selected six of eight pairs from exactly these numbers and the freeze check then stopped the run

dropped_from_the_tree.what_it_does: adds a combination to the recorded order that the tree cannot produce, and re-plans
dropped_from_the_tree.said: FATAL: the recorded tier-1 order names 1 combination(s) the tree no longer carries: a_row_the_tree_does_not_have
dropped_from_the_tree.why: the recorded order would describe a manifest this repository can no longer produce, so it stops rather than silently shrinking

pair_component_missing.what_it_does: names a tier-2 pair whose two halves are not tier-1 rows
pair_component_missing.said: FATAL: the recorded tier-2 selection pairs 2 combination(s) the tree no longer carries: alsoGone, gone
pair_component_missing.why: these eight pairs are what phase D ran and phase E was frozen against

record_is_never_rewritten.what_it_does: re-plans with the record present and hashes it before and after
record_is_never_rewritten.why: batch 16 fixed one recomputed field and left the recomputation; batch 24 had to come back for the file. A record of a decision is written once

refreeze_from_cold.what_it_does: removes the record and runs the freeze path from cold
refreeze_from_cold.why: the freeze path is kept for a reader implementing this method, and it must still produce the decision this project actually took
